genericProblem: P6 interaction designs could render a business reference or query as a generic text field because the admission standard did not require a finite, source-backed search-design denominator to distinguish text matching, fixed vocabularies, owner candidates and unsupported criteria.
rootCauseClass: The input-control dependency table explains cascade after a form control exists, but does not force the designer to prove that a list filter or searchable candidate control should exist, what business question it answers, or whether the contract actually exposes it.
finiteDenominator: Every P6 IA02-IA05 screen with list query, filter, search, candidate lookup, searchable Select, Cascader or candidate multi-select
A visible table column is excluded unless an original business task and owner/contract source establish it as a criterion
A screen with no search task must be explicitly NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON
searchQueries: 筛选|搜索|查询|Select|Cascader|候选|搜索选择
counterexamples: A name or code query whose list contract provides a contains/exact query may remain an Input; it must not be turned into a pretend candidate selector.
A frozen status vocabulary is a fixed Select, not a backend search endpoint.
A project reference used to select an owned project must use an owner-returned searchable candidate control only if its corresponding task read/contract exists.
A list contract that omits projectId cannot truthfully offer a project filter until a separately approved contract change supplies it.

findings.evidence: IA04-STORE-PAGE declares a project filter, but getOperationsOrganizationStores exposes name, code, brandId, tenantId, headCompanyId and status—not projectId—so a generic project text field has neither user-appropriate semantics nor contract support.

OpenAPI query declaration is not by itself owner search semantics: current workspace user, platform organization overview, platform contract overview and operations store controllers omit declared criteria before their task reads. A UI must treat this as a GAP until the same owner applies the criteria server-side and calculates totals with the same predicate.
